title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
subtitle: Atlus · Nintendo 3DS
summary: Shin Megami Tensei IV is Atlus's Nintendo 3DS role-playing game about Flynn, a new samurai of the Eastern Kingdom of Mikado. His duties take him below the kingdom into a devastated Tokyo inhabited by demons and competing human factions. The journey moves between places whose beliefs give different answers to how people should live. Flynn's companions help expose those divisions, while the player assembles a changing party of demons. The story's choices develop alongside a battle system in which understanding the opposition can decide an encounter remarkably quickly.
body: Shin Megami Tensei IV is Atlus's Nintendo 3DS role-playing game about Flynn, a new samurai of the Eastern Kingdom of Mikado. His duties take him below the kingdom into a devastated Tokyo inhabited by demons and competing human factions. The journey moves between places whose beliefs give different answers to how people should live. Flynn's companions help expose those divisions, while the player assembles a changing party of demons. The story's choices develop alongside a battle system in which understanding the opposition can decide an encounter remarkably quickly.

Talking to a demon opens a negotiation instead of another exchange of attacks. It may demand money, items or a particular answer before agreeing to join. Recruited demons bring different resistances and skills, then supply material for fusion into another form. Choosing which abilities the new demon inherits lets the party change without discarding everything learned along the way. Flynn can also acquire skills from his companions. The collection is a set of possible roles, with each new recruit offering another answer to a dangerous matchup.

The Press Turn system rewards exploiting weaknesses and landing critical hits with additional actions. A blocked or absorbed attack can waste opportunities instead. These rules apply to both sides, so an enemy can turn one exposed resistance into a damaging sequence. Preparation involves inspecting the party's weaknesses as carefully as its strongest attacks. Flynn explores three-dimensional streets and interiors between these battles, taking requests that reveal more of Tokyo. The city supplies the people and factions whose conflicting hopes give his growing strength a direction.
story_headings: An enemy can become an ally
